pq1:16.rule: Cash is not working capital: take it out of the current assets increase. Then multiply BOTH the net fixed investment and the working capital investment by (1 − DR).

hl: little relation to its ability to pay
pq1:17.rule: Dividends far from FCFE and unrelated to capacity: use FCFE, not a dividend discount model.

pq1:21.rule: You may say you hold the designation. You may not link it to better returns or to being a better analyst.

pq1:30.rule: Long forward value = S₀ − F₀ ÷ (1 + r)^(T − t), using the time left (4/12). The result is a value today, so the forward price is discounted.

hl: normal accruals explained by a regression on business activity, and the residual
pq1:33.rule: Explained by the regression = normal (non-discretionary). Residual = unusual (discretionary), the warning sign of manipulation.

hl: three-year forward rate two years from now, f(2,3)
pq1:35.rule: F(j,k) = 1 ÷ (1 + f(j,k))^k. The exponent is k, the 3 years the bond still has after the forward date.

pq1:37.rule: The bonds already make Harlow PAY fixed. To end up floating, the swap must RECEIVE fixed (cancels the bond coupon) and pay floating.

hl: discount for lack of marketability is 20%
pq1:42.rule: The 25% is a control PREMIUM. Convert it: DLOC = 1 − 1/1.25 = 20%. Then total = 1 − (1 − DLOC)(1 − DLOM).

pq2:10.rule: Style = fund sensitivity minus benchmark sensitivity: market +0.15 (high beta), size +0.30 (small cap), value −0.30 (growth).

pq2:12.rule: Rates fall + callable = the call will be exercised: duration shortens, convexity turns negative (price compression).

hl: HTML tags, punctuation, numbers and extra white space
pq2:16.rule: Removing HTML tags, punctuation, numbers and white space = cleansing. Lowercasing, stop words, stemming and lemmatisation = wrangling.

pq2:22.rule: A calibrated tree reprices the benchmark bonds, so an option-free bond is worth the same as with spot rates. Volatility only matters for embedded options.

pq2:29.rule: Market 136.00 < model ≈ 138.76: the futures is cheap. Cheap futures = buy futures, short the note, lend (reverse cash-and-carry).

hl: An index fund that meets its objective exactly
pq2:34.rule: Meets its objective exactly = tracks the benchmark: active return 0, so the information ratio is 0.

pq2:42.rule: RSUs have no exercise price, but the unrecognised expense still counts as proceeds: dilutive shares = 60,000 − 900,000 ÷ 30 = 30,000.
